exposure: Feeding protocol during pRBCs transfusion (one feed withheld)
Feeding protocol during pRBCs transfusion (feeds withheld 4 hours before till 4 hours after)
cohort: The study included 90 preterm neonates who received packed red blood cells (pRBCs) during their admission in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU).
finding: The incidence of TANEC and other complications of prematurity was relatively higher in preterms who had only one feed withheld during pRBCs transfusion compared to those whose feeds were withheld 4 hours before till 4 hours after pRBCs transfusion.
